“The Jewish man, Mordecai, was the most important Jew in the...”
An instruction regarding sacrificial regulations in the temple sanctuary
A general genealogy and listing of tribal leaders (3)
10.correctAnswer: “The Jewish man, Mordecai, was the most important Jew in the...”
10.explanation: Esther 10:3 records: 'The Jewish man, Mordecai, was the most important Jew in the whole kingdom. Only King Xerxes himself had more authority than Mordecai. The other Jews respected Mordecai because he worked hard to help them. He asked the king to make sure that all his people could live safely.'.
